title: Replacement Body Panels & Parts Depreciation
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 3 (Collision Repair), Clause 3.3
text: When repair requires replacement of bolt-on body components (e.g. bumpers, fenders, doors, lamps, or hood), replacement parts shall be sourced from certified OEM or manufacturer-approved suppliers. A scheduled depreciation deduction may apply to the cost of new parts depending on the vehicle age from first registration date, while paint and labor charges are reimbursed in full.
